title: Blueprints
summary: Bag items that open the locked recipes at the Crafting Altar. A blueprint is typed and tiered - 'a Legendary Hat Blueprint' - rather than tied to one cosmetic: using it consumes it and permanently unlocks a random locked recipe of that type and rarity you do not already have; when you already know every recipe it could open, it pays out a bundle of materials of similar worth instead. They stack, so holding two is two chances at two different recipes. They are their own group in the Bag's Materials category (blueprints), not gathering materials and not cosmetics themselves.
how_to_access: View owned Blueprints in the Bag under Materials, or on the Crafting Altar's Chests & blueprints tab. Use one there: select it, then click its preview card, which also lists which recipes it could still open. A locked recipe shows on the craft tab as a grey '???' tile naming the blueprint that opens it.

entries.name: Legendary Hat Blueprint
entries.description: Unlocks a Legendary hat recipe at the altar.
entries.how_to_get: A possible outcome of the guaranteed "chase" roll when opening a Rare Crate.
entries.how_to_use: At the altar's Chests & blueprints tab. Currently the only Legendary hat recipe is the Golden Crown (900 Base Material, 150 Leather, 70 Forged Steel, 11 Rainbow Powder, 10 Stardust, 6,000 coins; roughly a 12-hour craft), so the first one always opens that; a second one pays 900 Base Material, 11 Rainbow Powder and 10 Stardust instead.
entries.icon_hint: a rolled blueprint sheet with a small hat drawn on it; the rarity shows as a golden name and a Legendary tag in the tooltip
entries.notes: Stackable and consumed on use. Real texture: rc_cosmetics/resourcepack/rc_cosmetics/textures/item/blueprint_hat.png (shared by every hat blueprint of any rarity).

entries.name: Epic Body Blueprint
entries.description: Unlocks an Epic body cosmetic recipe at the altar.
entries.how_to_get: A possible outcome of the guaranteed "chase" roll when opening a Rare Crate.
entries.how_to_use: At the altar's Chests & blueprints tab. Currently the only Epic body recipe is the Jetpack (500 Base Material, 100 Warm Powder, 30 Forged Steel, 4 Rainbow Powder, 2,000 coins; roughly a 4-hour craft); a second one pays 500 Base Material, 30 Forged Steel and 4 Rainbow Powder instead.
entries.icon_hint: a rolled blueprint sheet with a small backpack shape drawn on it
entries.notes: Stackable and consumed on use. Real texture: rc_cosmetics/resourcepack/rc_cosmetics/textures/item/blueprint_body.png.

entries.name: Mythic Wings Blueprint
entries.description: Unlocks a Mythic wings recipe at the altar.
entries.how_to_get: A possible outcome of the guaranteed "chase" roll when opening a Rare Crate - the rarest of the three Blueprint outcomes in that pool, making this the hardest Blueprint to find.
entries.how_to_use: At the altar's Chests & blueprints tab. Currently the only Mythic wings recipe is Angel Wings (1,500 Base Material, 200 Cold Powder, 100 Glow Powder, 14 Luck Essence, 16 Stardust, 12,000 coins - the most expensive recipe on the network; roughly a 24-hour craft); a second one pays 1,500 Base Material, 14 Luck Essence and 16 Stardust instead.
entries.icon_hint: a rolled blueprint sheet with a small pair of wings drawn on it
entries.notes: Wings are worn as a body cosmetic but have their own blueprint type, so a Body blueprint can never open them and this one can never open the Jetpack. Real texture: rc_cosmetics/resourcepack/rc_cosmetics/textures/item/blueprint_wings.png.

open_questions: Blueprint icons for balloon and off-hand types exist in the resource pack, but no balloon or off-hand recipe is currently locked, so no blueprint item of those types is defined yet.
